title.romaji: Mujikaku Seijo wa Kyou mo Muishiki ni Chikara wo Tare Nagasu
title.english: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power
title.native: 無自覚聖女は今日も無意識に力を垂れ流す

synonyms: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power Glossary
description:
Lady Carolina, the overlooked daughter of a powerful duke, has always believed herself to be the black sheep amid her illustrious kin. Her father is the distinguished prime minister; her elder sister, a prodigious mage destined to become their nation’s next Saint. In comparison, Carolina resigns herself to a quiet existence in their shadows until a sudden and unexpected royal decree alters her destiny, thrusting her into a political marriage with the formidable “Bloodthirsty Prince” of the neighboring Empire of Malcosias. Determined to prove her worth, Carolina takes a bold step into a world fraught with both political and mortal peril. As royal obligations intertwine with hints of true love and the stirrings of her own latent power, Carolina moves ever closer to understanding what it truly means to be exceptional.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

name.native: カロリーナ・サンチェス
alternative: Carolina Ruby Martinez (カロリーナ・ルビー・マルティネス)

node.description:
A young lady from a ducal family in the Kingdom of Celestia who has been scorned and labeled a failure by those around her. She harbors a sense of inferiority, often finding herself compared to her talented older sister, [Flora](https://anilist.co/character/369748/Sanchez-Flora).

Though she is reserved and lacks self-confidence, she gradually begins to adopt a more positive outlook after meeting [Edward](https://anilist.co/character/369749/Ruby-Martinez-Edward).

name.native: エドワード・ルビー・マルティネス

node.description:
The Second Prince of the Marcosias Empire and Carolina’s fiancé. Although rumored to be "barbaric" and "unrelentingly cruel," he is actually a straightforward man with a strong sense of justice, albeit a somewhat clumsy one.

He is the leader of the "Blazing Phoenix Corps" and a wielder of fire magic.

name.native: マリッサ・キッシンジャー

node.description:
The third daughter of the Count Kissinger family of the Marchosias Empire. A capable woman who is cool-headed, reserved, and handles everything with effortless competence. She is reputed to be one of the most beautiful women in the empire.

Having left her family for a certain reason, she comes to serve as Carolina's lady-in-waiting.

name.native: テオドール・ガルシア

node.description:
He serves as an aide to [Edward](https://anilist.co/character/369749/Ruby-Martinez-Edward) and is the second son of a viscount's family.

As the vice-commander of the "Order of the Blazing Phoenix," he is a highly capable individual possessing both genius-level magical prowess and the strategic intellect that underpins the order's operations. He is also a childhood friend of Edward, and when the situation demands it, he does not hesitate to take a firm stance with him—despite Edward's status as a prince.

name.native: フローラ・サンチェス

node.description:
Carolina’s older sister and the daughter of a ducal family in the Kingdom of Celestia. Renowned for both her beauty and intellect, she excels in every field and is hailed as the next Saintess.

For a certain reason, she regards Carolina with hostility, often hurling cruel, scornful words at her.

name.native: ギルバート・ルビー・マルティネス

node.description:
The First Prince of the Marcosias Empire and Edward's older brother. He is gentle, intelligent, and personable.

He suffers from a condition known as Mana Hypersensitivity Syndrome, an ailment that has plagued him for years. Although his symptoms are currently being temporarily suppressed by the Holy Power of His Holiness the Pope, he is unable to step even a single foot outside the Diamond Palace, which is enclosed by a special barrier.

name.native: オーウェン・クライン

node.description:
The second son of the Baron Klein family of the Marchosias Empire. He is straightforward, guileless, and speaks his mind without reservation. For a certain reason, he holds no attachment to money, status, his family, or even his own life.

He is a member of the "Blazing Phoenix Order" and serves as a bodyguard knight for [Carolina](https://anilist.co/character/369750/Sanchez-Carolina).
